description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark purple, solid). All lines start at a loss of approximately 3.4 at 0 iterations and decrease as the number of iterations increases. The Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64, H/T), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=128) lines decrease to around 2.5 at 140000 iterations, with the Vanilla line having the lowest loss, while the StrmLLM (n=64) and SepLLM (n=64) lines decrease to around 2.6 at 140000 iterations. The lines generally exhibit a sharp decline in loss between 0 and 20000 iterations, followed by a more gradual decrease.
